scientific_integrity: Constructive mathematical proof with standard-library exact-rational examples and finite checks, which do not certify universal quantified statements. Scientific review is not independent.
scientific_limitations: Exact real rank-two PSD inputs, one diagonal-proportional random pivot, and variable ambient dimension in the realization theorem only; does not cover fixed dimension realizability, rank greater than two, multiple pivots, floating-point effects or typical-input distributions. The mean identity and general Markov and convexity steps are known or elementary, not claimed as original. Possible historical overlap with generalized frame-realization literature remains.
title: Complete fixed-spectrum one-pivot risk laws for rank-two randomized Cholesky
